name: HDB Financial Services Ltd
title: HDB Financial Services Ltd - 544429 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: HDB Financial Q4 FY26 shows credit-cost and Stage 3 improvement (GNPA 2.44% vs 2.81%) and record disbursements of ₹19,922 crore, but book growth of 3.4% QoQ and no supply-side discipline story; a growth-recovery read, not a capital-cycle trigger.

triggers.label: Q4 disbursements ₹19,922 cr, highest ever
triggers.quote: Disbursements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, was ₹19,922 crores, up 11.2% sequentially – an all-time high

triggers.label: Gross Stage 3 2.44% vs 2.81%
triggers.quote: Gross Stage 3 as at March 31, 2026, was 2.44% as against 2.81% as at March 31, 2025.

triggers.label: NIM 8.23% vs 8.09% QoQ
triggers.quote: Net interest margin for Q4 FY26 was 8.23% vs 8.09% in Q3 FY26

guidance.quote: we look at a Nominal GDP + 6% to 7% growth and we're very focused on making sure we deliver to that
we wished for it to moderate in the range of 2.3% plus/minus
an 8 %+ is a non -negotiable the way we treat it internally today
I think we will range around 3.7%

red_flags.label: Asset finance Stage 3 volatility and K-shaped recovery
red_flags.quote: the recovery has been slight ly K-shaped. And what do I mean by that?

red_flags.label: Management declined to disclose write-offs and some metrics
red_flags.quote: we'll pick it up offline in terms of the number as such

red_flags.label: Stage 1 PCR up 30 bps with no specific explanation
red_flags.quote: There has been a sharp 30 bps increase on Stage 1 PCR.

evasions.quote: we'll pick it up. It will be there in the financials. I think we just pick it up offline

evasions.topic: Contingency provisions for West Asia stress
evasions.quote: we haven't seen any specific level two /level three impact coming through, is the way I would put it
So there's nothing specific that I would want to highlight
